summary: The change defers action locking during blur-triggered text saves, queues delete or clear behind pending saves, and adds regression coverage for both actions across all text fields.

evidence: public/admin_users.js lines 509-518: text blur saves call saveUser with deferActionLock true.
public/admin_users.js lines 66-94: deferred saves leave delete and clear buttons enabled, while busy counts keep them locked once the action starts.
public/admin_users.js lines 427-477: delete and clear reserve a busy lock and wait for pending user and password saves before issuing DELETE.
tests/admin_users_test.ts lines 47-160: regression coverage exercises handle, email, and display-name blur saves followed by both Delete user and Clear password clicks.
